Welcome to EZBudget 👋
Let's set up your budget in a few quick steps.
Which accounts and bills apply to you?
Select all that apply. You can add more later.

Enter your account details

Income setup
Pay Schedule
Enter your typical income range. Budget Planning uses the low amount to guarantee bills are covered, and the typical amount to plan savings.
Low Pay
Typical Pay
High Pay
Employers (optional)
Add your employer(s) for vacation-pay tracking and accurate tax-year grouping. Leave blank to skip — you can edit these anytime in Settings → Employer & Vacation Pay.
Tax rates (optional)
Used to estimate net pay and taxes owed. Enter your marginal rates, or load a full country/province preset later on the Taxes page. Leave a field blank to keep its current value.
Rates (%)
Subscriptions & recurring charges (optional)
Review your recurring services or add new ones. Leave a blank row empty to skip — full details can be edited later on the Payments page.
Savings & sinking funds (optional)
Set a monthly amount to save into each account, and plan ahead for big irregular expenses with sinking funds.
Monthly savings targets
Sinking funds (planned big expenses)
Region & display (optional)
Set your currency/region, theme, and how large the interface appears.
Notifications & finish
Bill reminders
Foreground only — EZBudget has no server. Your browser may ask permission to show notifications.
You're all set 🎉
